inherited_inputs.source: Section2 adopts Karkoschka2003 image ellipsoid; effective33km; no new image-derived axes or local normal.
inherited_inputs.spin: Tidal-locking assumed for centrifugal term in sub-Neptune ellipsoid model; not independent spin observation or dated facing site.
inherited_inputs.Table3: Simulation mean Neptune radius24764km, Naiad33, Thalassa41, Despina75; do not silently replace catalogue or JPL equivalents.
inherited_inputs.age: OrderGyr dynamical age conditional on initially low inclination, convergent tidal migration and uncertain Neptune k2/Q, masses and history. Not direct age measurement.
inherited_inputs.history_alternatives: Recent convergent-migration resonance inclination interpretation differs from earlier lower-order-capture explanation; preserve both histories. Despina/Thalassa resonance-lock speculation not direct Neptune-mode detection.

models.tidal: MacCullagh ellipsoid gravity plus tides and assumed synchronous rotation; Drucker-Prager with assumed35deg friction. Nominal ≥10kPa cohesion, densityaround1.3g/cm3/less elongation alternatives; conditional strength requirements, not measured cohesion or verified imminent disruption.
models.heliocentric: Calibrated population impact model extrapolated through uncertain Trojan/Charon/Arrokoth small-object SFD and crater-projectile scaling; Table1 probability relative to Jupiter. Naiad >10km impact rate1.2e-11/yr is model, not observed impacts. Disruption threshold unknown; asteroid/KBO analogues not Naiad chemistry or skins.
models.sesquinary: REBOUND/TRACE/ReboundX, Neptune/Naiad/Thalassa/Despina and test particles only; J2/J4, initial NAIF SPICE states; other moons and solar tides neglected. Nominal million orbital periods about800yr. Initial10m projectile20km/s, strength1–10MPa.
models.ejecta: Fixed10m particles with target density; random hemisphere launch; no particle-particle interactions/collision search. HH11 crater scaling uses DART/Dimorphos simulation parameters as modelling proxy, not Naiad measured material. Mass/momentum adjusted, angular momentum not perfectly conserved.1MPa run haltedaround200yr due growth.
models.interpretation: SeveralMPa protection/possible monolithic fragment are conditional interpretations; not detected interior. Grinding/PR removal/deepfine-regolith alternative scenarios need more sophisticated modelling. No ring/torus detection or regolith thickness adopted.

association_caution: Sections2/5 group Proteus/Larissa/Galatea phyllosilicate signatures broadly. Preserve independently assessed Davis2026 body-specific results: strong2.72Mg-clay interpretation for Larissa/Galatea, absent/weaker Proteus2.72 and unknown OH carrier; do not assign their Mg-clays or ice nondetections to Naiad. No Naiad direct spectrum/local fractions measured here. Nondetection does not establish absence.
